about.description: Classify Markdown notes and see their classifications in the file explorer and note header.
about.author: By {author}
intro.title: Getting started with Classificator
intro.noteDescription: Use the note header badge, the file menu, or the command palette. Classificator saves your choice in the classification property.
intro.defaultsTitle: Set a default for new notes
intro.defaultsDescription: In Classificator settings, choose whether new empty notes get a default classification, prompt you, or wait for manual classification.
intro.foldersDescription: Open a folder’s context menu to set a default in _meta.md. In automatic mode, the folder value takes priority for new empty notes directly in that folder.
errors.openHelp: Classificator: Could not open the help dialog.
language.label: Language
folder.title: Folder rules
folder.description: Applies in automatic mode to new empty notes directly in this folder.
folder.applyAllDescription: Updates all existing Markdown notes in this folder and its subfolders. This option takes priority if both boxes are checked.
folder.applyUnclassifiedDescription: Updates Markdown notes in this folder and its subfolders with a missing or empty classification or the value unclassified.
settings.newNotesDescription: Choose how new empty Markdown notes are classified.
settings.noteBadgeDescription: Click the badge to change the note’s classification.
settings.removeClassification: Remove. Values already saved in notes are retained.
errors.noClassifications: Add a classification in Classificator settings.
errors.openClassification: Classificator: Could not open the classification dialog.
errors.folderSettings: Classificator: Could not read or save folder rules.
errors.folderRead: Classificator: Could not read folder rules for “{name}”.
errors.invalidClassification: Use 1–40 characters from a–z, 0–9, hyphens or underscores. Start with a letter or digit.
